CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (position), an explicit presentation/organization statement, and a separate origin/status field are present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content lines identify colored items at specific coordinates (content plus attribute).

D.rationale: Origin/status fields and execution flags are stated separately from the listed content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The report states coordinate orientation and explicitly labels items as current vs candidate peaks and presents their organized coordinate listings.
